notes: Depths in metres from finished ground. cover_to_top_m is to the top of the uppermost cable or duct. phase_spacing_mm is centre to centre within one circuit; circuit_spacing_mm is between circuits as the named source measures it. Values marked typical are from project drawings or derived by arithmetic, not from a DNO rule. Sources are keyed in docs/trench-sources.md.
